verdict.rationale: The evidence documents per-repository cloud environments, MCP configuration shared across one user's own clients, and plugins that connect Codex to team tools. None of it shows Codex letting a lead build a shared team workspace from docs and repos as a common source of truth. These are adjacent features, not the capability itself, and the RBAC item covers the OpenAI API platform rather than a Codex workspace.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team
